verdict.rationale: Fellow documents in-product, AI-generated output from meeting data: automatic meeting summaries, suggested AI action items, decisions and topic-based minutes for every meeting. 'Ask Fellow' appears as a plan feature but is not described. The MCP server only lets external assistants query this data, so it is not credited as in-product insight. Missing for 10: documented in-product cross-meeting insights or a Q&A experience (Ask Fellow is only named), proactive suggestions beyond per-meeting action items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
